projects.name: openclaw
projects.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
projects.summary_zh: 生产级跨平台 AI 助手 | 安全发布与插件化工程基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform AI assistant with strong release security and extensibility foundations
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署，建议持续关注工作流复杂度
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production; monitor growing workflow complexity
highlights_zh: Docker 多阶段构建、基础镜像摘要锁定并支持插件按需裁剪，兼顾可复现性与部署效率
发布流程实施最小权限、目标提交校验、证明产物校验和不可信执行器隔离
highlights_en: Multi-stage Docker builds pin base-image digests and support selective plugin inclusion
Release workflows enforce least privilege, exact-target validation, approval attestations, and runner isolation
concerns_zh: Docker 插件筛选逻辑与发布工作流较为复杂，后续变更的审计和回归成本较高
部分镜像中的系统软件包未固定版本，跨时重建的完全一致性仍有限
concerns_en: Plugin-selection logic and release workflows are complex, increasing audit and regression costs
Some system packages are not version-pinned, limiting fully reproducible rebuilds

projects.name: jcode
projects.description: High performance coding agent harness written in Rust, built for heavy multi-agent dev workflows
projects.summary_zh: 高性能 Rust 多智能体编码框架，工程护栏与跨平台能力突出
projects.summary_en: High-performance Rust coding-agent harness with strong engineering guardrails and cross-platform support
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队级重度多智能体开发
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for team-scale multi-agent development
highlights_zh: 按运行时、协议、提供商与TUI职责拆分大量独立crate，模块边界清晰
CI覆盖格式、Clippy、依赖锁定、代码规模、错误吞噬及跨平台验收
highlights_en: Extensive crate decomposition clearly separates runtime, protocol, provider, and TUI responsibilities
CI enforces formatting, Clippy, lockfiles, code budgets, error handling, and cross-platform acceptance
concerns_zh: crate数量众多且依赖面较广，长期演进时需持续控制模块耦合与升级成本
当前样本以清单和CI为主，核心实现的异常恢复及并发正确性证据有限
concerns_en: The large crate and dependency surface may increase long-term coupling and upgrade costs
The sample mainly exposes manifests and CI, limiting direct evidence of runtime error recovery and concurrency correctness

projects.name: zeroclaw
projects.description: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, any OS, any platform — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀
projects.summary_zh: 生产级模块化 Rust 智能体基础设施 | 跨平台交付与插件生态完善
projects.summary_en: Production-grade modular Rust agent infrastructure with strong cross-platform delivery and plugin support
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管部署，落地前重点审计权限与插件安全
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosting; audit privileges and plugin security before deployment
highlights_zh: 工作区按 API、运行时、渠道、工具、插件等领域拆分，依赖集中管理
提供生成式安装与容器构建、固定摘要镜像、跨平台 CI 和插件产物验证
highlights_en: Domain-oriented Rust workspace with centralized dependency management
Generated installers and containers, digest-pinned images, cross-platform CI, and plugin artifact verification
concerns_zh: 功能面覆盖渠道、工具和外部服务，系统攻击面与长期维护成本较高
样本主要为构建和运维配置，缺少核心运行时源码、测试结果及安全审计证据
concerns_en: Broad channel, tool, and external-service support increases attack surface and maintenance cost
The sample mainly covers build and operations configuration, without core runtime source, test results, or security-audit evidence

projects.name: pi
projects.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
projects.summary_zh: 生产级模块化 AI Agent 工具箱 | 扩展与跨平台交付能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade modular AI agent toolkit with strong extensibility and cross-platform delivery
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合二次开发，敏感环境须先沙箱隔离
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for extension; sandbox before sensitive use
highlights_zh: 按 AI、Agent、TUI、持久化等领域拆分独立包，职责边界清晰
具备类型检查、静态检查、分层测试、MCP 一致性测试及跨平台发布流水线
highlights_en: Clear package boundaries across AI, agent, TUI, durability, and tooling layers
Combines type checking, linting, layered tests, MCP conformance, and cross-platform releases
concerns_zh: 默认无文件、进程、网络及凭据权限隔离，高风险使用必须依赖容器或沙箱
要求 Node.js 22.19 以上，且安装命令采用远程脚本直执行，供应链审计需额外关注
concerns_en: No built-in filesystem, process, network, or credential isolation; containers or sandboxes are required for risky use
Requires Node.js 22.19+ and remote-script installation increases supply-chain review requirements

projects.name: codeshell
projects.description: An open-source AI coding assistant for your terminal, inspired by Claude Code. Interact with your codebase directly from the command line.
projects.summary_zh: 模块化、发布链路成熟的多形态 AI 编排框架
projects.summary_en: A modular AI orchestration framework with mature multi-client release infrastructure
projects.recommendation_zh: 功能成熟，适合试用，规模化采用前需评估维护风险
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; assess maintainer concentration before large-scale adoption
highlights_zh: 核心机制与编码能力物理分包，CLI、桌面端和SDK复用统一引擎
CI覆盖类型检查、安全守卫、端到端测试、发布恢复与多平台构建
highlights_en: Core mechanisms and coding capabilities are physically separated and reused by CLI, desktop, and SDK clients
CI covers type checking, safety guards, end-to-end testing, release recovery, and multi-platform builds
concerns_zh: 项目仍处于0.9.x阶段且贡献者仅2人，长期维护与Bus factor存在风险
构建和运行主要绑定Bun及Electron原生依赖，增加供应链与升级复杂度
concerns_en: The project remains pre-1.0 with only two contributors, creating long-term maintenance and bus-factor risk
Build and runtime workflows depend heavily on Bun and Electron native modules, increasing supply-chain and upgrade complexity

projects.name: nanobot
projects.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化完备的轻量个人智能体框架 | 发布供应链成熟
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered lightweight personal agent framework with mature release supply-chain practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管试点，核心场景验证后再生产采用
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted pilots; validate core workloads before production adoption
highlights_zh: Ruff、严格类型检查、75%覆盖率门槛与跨平台CI形成质量门禁
发布候选验证、制品哈希绑定、Sigstore签名及原生包验收流程完善
highlights_en: Ruff, strict type checking, a 75% coverage gate, and cross-platform CI provide strong quality controls
Release-candidate verification, artifact hash binding, Sigstore signing, and native-package acceptance are comprehensive
concerns_zh: 项目仍标记为Alpha，核心智能体与渠道实现未包含在样本中，无法验证运行时错误处理质量
核心依赖与可选渠道较多，Docker运行时安装渠道依赖会增加供应链和升级复杂度
concerns_en: The project remains Alpha, and the sampled files do not expose the core agent or channel implementations needed to assess runtime error handling
The large core dependency set and runtime installation of channel dependencies increase supply-chain and upgrade complexity

projects.name: microclaw
projects.description: 🦀An agentic AI assistant that lives in your chats, inspired by nanoclaw and incorporating some of its design ideas. Built with Rust 🦀
projects.summary_zh: 生产级模块化 Rust 智能体平台 | 多端部署与可靠扩展基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade modular Rust agent platform with a strong multi-platform and extensibility foundation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产选型，优先采用稳定分支并审查依赖风险
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production adoption via the stable branch, with dependency risk review recommended
highlights_zh: 核心引擎与SDK按工作区解耦，统一服务端、桌面端和嵌入式产品形态
CI覆盖多操作系统、Clippy、测试、覆盖率、安全审计、Nix、Docker及Web端到端测试
highlights_en: The workspace separates the core engine and SDK while sharing one runtime across server, desktop, and embedded products
CI spans multiple operating systems, Clippy, tests, coverage, security audits, Nix, Docker, and browser end-to-end testing
concerns_zh: 依赖与功能面较广，供应链治理和升级成本仍需持续关注
安全审计流程暂忽略多项RUSTSEC告警，升级依赖时需重新评估
主分支允许破坏性变更，生产集成应固定稳定分支或发布版本
concerns_en: The broad dependency and feature surface creates ongoing supply-chain and upgrade costs
The security workflow currently suppresses multiple RUSTSEC advisories that require reassessment during dependency upgrades
The main branch permits breaking changes, so production integrations should pin the stable branch or a release

projects.name: hermes-agent
projects.description: The agent that grows with you
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多平台自进化代理 | 供应链治理与扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-platform self-improving agent with strong supply-chain governance and extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署，建议先做安全与兼容性试点
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production trials after focused security and compatibility validation
highlights_zh: 依赖精确锁定并使用锁文件与制品校验，强化供应链可重复性
支持多操作系统、终端后端、模型提供商及插件扩展
highlights_en: Exact dependency pins, lockfiles, and artifact verification improve supply-chain reproducibility
Broad support for operating systems, terminal backends, model providers, and plugins
concerns_zh: Node.js 26等激进版本要求可能降低旧环境兼容性
功能与部署面较广，源码样本有限，生产采用仍需专项安全审计
concerns_en: Aggressive requirements such as Node.js 26 may reduce compatibility with older environments
The broad feature and deployment surface requires focused security auditing before production adoption

projects.name: claude-hud
projects.description: A Claude Code plugin that shows what's happening - context usage, active tools, running agents, and todo progress
projects.summary_zh: 安全边界清晰、跨平台验证充分的高成熟度 Claude Code 状态栏插件
projects.summary_en: A mature Claude Code statusline plugin with strong security boundaries and broad cross-platform validation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产使用，建议先验证受限环境兼容性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production use after validating constrained-environment compatibility
highlights_zh: 采用受限 Node 进程、导入围栏和独立命令执行文件，安全边界设计明确
CI 覆盖 Linux、macOS、Windows、Node 18至26及 Bun，并执行端到端与逃逸测试
highlights_en: Uses a restricted Node process, import fence, and isolated command runner with explicit security boundaries
CI validates Linux, macOS, Windows, Node 18 through 26, and Bun with end-to-end and escape tests
concerns_zh: 源码样本未包含核心实现与测试代码，模块边界和异常处理质量无法直接核验
运行时依赖 Node 22.18及较新的 Claude Code，较旧终端环境需额外启动器兼容
concerns_en: Core implementation and tests are absent from the sample, so module boundaries and error handling cannot be directly verified
Runtime requires Node 22.18 or newer and a recent Claude Code version, increasing legacy-environment friction

projects.name: qwen-code
projects.description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多渠道编码代理 | 工程治理与扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-channel coding agent with strong engineering governance and extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队级部署，需评估Node 22与系统权限依赖
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for team deployment; assess Node 22 and system privilege dependencies
highlights_zh: 采用TypeScript多工作区架构，支持多模型供应商与多聊天渠道扩展
具备分层测试、发布流水线、CI预算与工作流体积基线等持续治理机制
Docker基础镜像采用摘要锁定，并配套沙箱及CI主机资源清理方案
highlights_en: Uses a TypeScript monorepo with extensible support for multiple model providers and chat channels
Provides layered testing, release pipelines, CI budgets, and workflow-size baselines
Pins Docker base images by digest and includes sandbox and CI-host cleanup mechanisms
concerns_zh: 要求Node.js 22及以上，部分运维流程依赖Linux、systemd及sudo权限
自动化工作流规模庞大，运行时核心源码覆盖不足，错误处理能力难以从样本充分验证
concerns_en: Requires Node.js 22+, while some operational flows depend on Linux, systemd, and sudo access
Large automated workflows and limited runtime-source coverage make error-handling quality difficult to verify fully

projects.name: oh-my-pi
projects.description: ⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多语言智能体平台｜工程化与扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-language coding agent with strong engineering and extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队生产部署，建议先验证 Bun 与 Rust 依赖
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production teams; validate Bun and Rust dependencies first
highlights_zh: TypeScript 与 Rust 分层清晰，具备完整的类型检查、lint、格式化及多语言测试流程
工作区、版本目录、CI/CD 与多阶段容器构建形成较完善的工程化体系
highlights_en: Clear TypeScript and Rust layering with type checking, linting, formatting, and multi-language testing
Strong workspace, dependency catalog, CI/CD, and multi-stage container build foundations
concerns_zh: Bun、Rust、N-API 与原生插件组合显著提高构建、调试和供应链维护成本
约 8 万行 Rust 核心及多个 vendored crate 带来升级负担与长期分叉风险
concerns_en: The Bun, Rust, N-API, and native-addon stack raises build, debugging, and supply-chain costs
An ~80k-line Rust core and multiple vendored crates create upgrade and long-term fork risks

projects.name: kilocode
projects.description: Kilo is the all-in-one agentic engineering platform. Build, ship, and iterate faster with the most popular open source coding agent.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多端 AI 编程平台 | 安全自动化与跨平台交付完善
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-platform AI coding platform with strong security automation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队规模化采用，建议先验证核心服务稳定性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for large-scale adoption; validate core service stability first
highlights_zh: 采用 TypeScript 与 Bun workspace，并集成 lint、类型检查、架构及重复代码检查
CI 权限最小化并隔离不可信 PR 内容，安全工作流具备失败处理和去重机制
highlights_en: TypeScript and Bun workspaces with linting, type checking, architecture, and duplication checks
Least-privilege CI workflows safely isolate untrusted PR content with failure handling and deduplication
concerns_zh: 根目录 test 脚本被刻意禁用，测试入口分散且完整验证成本较高
依赖目录包含 beta 版本及预发布仓库地址，升级兼容性和构建可复现性仍需关注
concerns_en: The root test command is intentionally disabled, resulting in fragmented test entry points
Beta dependencies and prerelease repository URLs may affect compatibility and build reproducibility

projects.name: notebooklm-py
projects.description: Unofficial Python API and agentic skill for Google Gemini Notebook. Full programmatic access to Gemini Notebook's features—including capabilities the web UI doesn't expose—via Python, CLI, and AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw.
projects.summary_zh: 面向代理编排的非官方 NotebookLM Python SDK，工程质量较高但依赖内部接口
projects.summary_en: A high-quality unofficial NotebookLM Python SDK for agent orchestration, constrained by internal API volatility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型与研究，生产接入需锁定版本并评估接口风险
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototypes and research; pin versions and assess breakage risk before production use
highlights_zh: 依赖版本设有明确上限并通过 uv.lock 固化环境，兼顾可复现性与下游兼容性
CI 覆盖 CodeQL、依赖审计、跨平台多 Python 版本测试及故障压力场景
highlights_en: Dependencies use explicit upper bounds and a locked environment, balancing reproducibility and downstream compatibility
CI includes CodeQL, dependency auditing, cross-platform multi-Python testing, and fault-stress scenarios
concerns_zh: 依赖未公开的 Google 内部接口，端点、认证或响应结构可能随时失效
项目仍处于 Beta，REST 服务等实验接口不承诺次版本兼容
concerns_en: It relies on undocumented Google internal APIs whose endpoints, authentication, or response schemas may change without notice
The project remains Beta, and experimental interfaces such as the REST server lack next-version compatibility guarantees

projects.name: cc-connect
projects.description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.
projects.summary_zh: 插件化多平台 AI 编码代理桥接器 | 工程化成熟但安全基线可加强
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered, extensible bridge for multi-platform AI coding agents with room to strengthen security controls
highlights_zh: 核心与适配器分层清晰，通过接口、能力检测和注册机制降低耦合
CI覆盖静态检查、竞态检测、单元测试、端到端及性能基准
highlights_en: Clean core-adapter separation with interfaces, capability checks, and registries
CI covers linting, race detection, unit tests, end-to-end scenarios, and benchmarks
concerns_zh: 所给样本缺少核心Go实现，无法验证架构原则的实际落地程度
CI缺少依赖漏洞扫描、SBOM、密钥扫描及明确的覆盖率门禁
concerns_en: The provided sample lacks core Go implementation, so adherence to the stated architecture cannot be verified
CI lacks dependency vulnerability scanning, SBOM generation, secret scanning, and an explicit coverage threshold

projects.name: pydantic-deepagents
projects.description: Open-source, self-hosted Claude Code - a terminal AI assistant and the Python framework behind it. Tool-calling, sandboxed execution, multi-agent teams, skills, checkpoints, unlimited context - on Pydantic AI, any model.
projects.summary_zh: 类型安全、扩展丰富的自托管多模型智能体框架，工程化基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Type-safe, extensible self-hosted multi-model agent framework with a solid engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合框架型选型，生产部署前验证依赖兼容性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for framework adoption; validate dependency compatibility before production
highlights_zh: 覆盖 Python 3.10-3.13 的测试矩阵，并集成 Ruff、Pyright、Mypy 与 Bandit
通过功能分组隔离 CLI、沙箱、MCP、浏览器、ACP 等可选能力
highlights_en: Python 3.10-3.13 test matrix with Ruff, Pyright, Mypy, and Bandit integration
CLI, sandbox, MCP, browser, and ACP capabilities are cleanly isolated as optional extras
concerns_zh: 核心依赖主要仅设置最低版本且未提交锁文件，长期依赖可复现性不足
项目仍处于 Beta，且源码样本有限，核心实现的异常处理与测试覆盖深度无法完全验证
concerns_en: Core dependencies mostly use lower bounds without a committed lockfile, weakening long-term reproducibility
The project remains beta, and the limited source sample prevents full verification of exception handling and test depth

projects.name: llama-terminal-completion
projects.description: AI terminal assistant for any OpenAI-compatible API. Features interactive chat TUI, command generation, code explanation, and streaming responses. Works with Ollama, OpenAI, LM Studio, and more.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化程度较高的多模型终端助手，扩展与安全机制完善但治理仍有提升空间
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered multi-model terminal assistant with strong extensibility and safety foundations, but with room for improved project governance.
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合开发辅助，生产部署前需强化安全与供应链治理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for development assistance; strengthen security and supply-chain governance before production use.
highlights_zh: 通过统一 Tool 接口、事件化 Agent 核心与 MCP 适配器形成清晰扩展体系
具备危险命令识别、写执行确认、审计日志、有限迭代和瞬态错误重试机制
highlights_en: A clear extension architecture built around a unified Tool interface, event-driven agent core, and MCP adapters
Includes dangerous-command detection, write and execution confirmation, audit logging, bounded iterations, and transient-error retries
concerns_zh: Makefile 与 GoReleaser 使用的内部模块路径不一致，可能导致本地版本注入失效
贡献者和发布次数较少，CI 未对发布的各目标平台执行二进制冒烟测试，且部分 CI 工具版本未锁定
concerns_en: The Makefile and GoReleaser configuration use inconsistent internal module paths, potentially breaking local version injection
The project has few contributors and releases, while CI does not smoke-test release binaries across target platforms and pins some tools only to latest versions

projects.name: laoHuangCode
projects.description: Open-source terminal AI coding assistant with multi-provider support, MCP integration, and session management.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化较完善的跨平台终端 AI 助手，适合快速试用与二次开发
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered cross-platform terminal AI assistant suited for rapid adoption and extension
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人开发与二次集成，生产使用前需评估工具执行安全
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for individual development and integration; assess tool-execution security before production use
highlights_zh: 提供六平台独立发行包、校验和、原子切换及升级恢复机制
采用 TypeScript workspace 分层架构，并配套构建、测试、烟测和发布流程
highlights_en: Provides six-platform standalone distributions with checksums, atomic switching, and upgrade recovery
Uses a layered TypeScript workspace with build, test, smoke, and release automation
concerns_zh: 工具调用默认无需确认且无操作系统级沙箱，存在误操作与供应链风险
PR CI 仅覆盖 Ubuntu，Node 22 与 macOS、Windows 的完整兼容性验证不足
concerns_en: Tool calls require no confirmation and lack an OS-level sandbox, creating misuse and supply-chain risks
PR CI covers only Ubuntu, leaving full Node 22, macOS, and Windows compatibility insufficiently verified

projects.name: ironclaw
projects.description: IronClaw is an Agent OS focused on privacy, security and extensibility
projects.summary_zh: 安全优先的模块化 Rust Agent OS，具备成熟工程护栏与插件扩展体系
projects.summary_en: A security-first, modular Rust Agent OS with mature engineering guardrails and extensible plugin architecture
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合重视安全隔离与扩展性的生产选型
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production teams prioritizing isolation and extensibility

Some publicly exposed services rely only on application authentication and require individual security review

The provided sample mainly contains documentation and CI configuration, limiting verification of core implementation and test coverage

projects.name: picobot
projects.description: A lightweight self-hosted bot in a single binary, written in Go.

projects.summary_en: Lightweight single-binary Go self-hosted AI agent | solid engineering baseline, thin release and dependency governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人自托管与低成本VPS，生产级部署需补充安全审计
projects.recommendation_en: Great for personal self-hosting on a cheap VPS; add security hardening before production use
highlights_zh: 零依赖单二进制，静态编译交叉编译多平台，容器镜像仅约29MB，可部署到树莓派等受限环境

CI runs lint/vet/test with an explicit golangci-lint linter set, and Docker publish uses multi-arch builds with GHA cache
concerns_zh: go.mod 模块名仍为 github.com/local/picobot，与仓库路径 louisho5/picobot 不一致，影响导入与协作
依赖 go 1.26 与 whatsmeow 等前沿版本，缺少 Dependabot/Renovate 与 CVE 扫描，供应链风险未闭环
Docker 发布仅支持手动 workflow_dispatch，未见 tag 触发的版本发布与自动回滚流程
CI 无覆盖率门槛与竞态检测（-race），且 exec/文件系统等高危工具缺少可见的沙箱与白名单约束
贡献者仅 7 人、发布 12 次，核心维护者集中度与巴士因子风险偏高
concerns_en: go.mod still declares github.com/local/picobot, mismatching the louisho5/picobot repository path
Depends on go 1.26 and cutting-edge whatsmeow releases with no Dependabot/Renovate or CVE scanning in place
Docker publishing is manual-dispatch only; no tag-triggered release pipeline or rollback path is visible
CI lacks coverage thresholds and -race runs, and no sandboxing/whitelisting for high-risk exec and filesystem tools is evident
Only 7 contributors and 12 releases, raising maintainer concentration and bus-factor risk

concerns_en: The lockfile is ignored and release installation is not frozen, weakening dependency reproducibility

projects.name: subzeroclaw
projects.description: An agent small enough to run anywhere. A minimal agentic runtime in C — ~380 lines, 54KB binary, ~2MB RAM. A skill file + an LLM + a shell loop, no framework.
projects.summary_zh: 极简直连执行型代理运行时 | 轻量但安全边界与上下文可靠性有限
projects.summary_en: Minimal direct-execution agent runtime | Lightweight but limited by safety and context reliability
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合实验与受控环境，不建议直接用于生产
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for experiments and controlled environments, not direct production use
highlights_zh: 单一C运行时配合技能文件、LLM和Shell循环，核心链路清晰且易于审阅
具备单元测试、集成测试、CI/CD、MIT许可证及系统库与vendored cJSON构建回退
highlights_en: Clear minimal core consisting of a skill file, LLM, shell, and loop, making the execution path easy to audit
Includes unit and integration tests, CI/CD, an MIT license, and a system-cJSON plus vendored fallback build
concerns_zh: 运行时无确认、沙箱或权限隔离，模型可直接执行任意Shell命令，误用或提示注入风险极高
直接模式会持续增长上下文直到服务端拒绝，异步压缩依赖外部路由且失败处理与并发边界仍需验证
仅依赖少数贡献者和单一维护者，且项目尚无正式发布记录，长期治理与兼容性保障有限
concerns_en: The runtime has no confirmation, sandboxing, or permission isolation; model output can execute arbitrary shell commands, creating severe misuse and prompt-injection risks
Standalone mode grows context until the provider rejects it, while asynchronous compaction depends on an external router and requires stronger validation of failure and concurrency handling
Reliance on very few contributors and a single maintainer, combined with no formal releases, limits long-term governance and compatibility assurance

projects.name: openclawWeComzh
projects.description: Open-source implementation of the AEON Protocol for advanced AI cognitive observability, featuring real-time dialectic flow tracking, automated memory distillation (Auto-Seal), and knowledge aging visualization.
projects.summary_zh: 大型多渠道 AI 网关的中文本地化分支，工程规范完整但已停止维护
projects.summary_en: Well-engineered Chinese-localized fork of a multi-channel AI gateway, though maintenance has been halted
projects.recommendation_zh: 可作中文参考实现，生产选型建议转向 OpenAEON 上游
projects.recommendation_en: Fine as a Chinese reference; for production prefer the upstream OpenAEON project
highlights_zh: 工程规范齐全：oxfmt 格式化、knip/ts-prune 死代码检测、500 行 TS 文件上限、自定义 lint 规则
插件化架构完善：plugin-sdk 独立 dts 导出、extensions/skills 机制与多沙箱 Docker 镜像
容器安全实践规范：镜像 digest 锁定、非 root 用户运行、可选 Chromium/Xvfb 浏览器沙箱
highlights_en: Strong engineering discipline: oxfmt, knip/ts-prune dead-code checks, 500-line TS file cap, custom lint rules
Well-structured extensibility: standalone plugin-sdk dts exports, extensions/skills system, multiple sandbox images
Sound container practices: digest-pinned images, non-root runtime user, optional Chromium/Xvfb browser sandbox
concerns_zh: README 首行声明项目已不再维护，升级需迁移至 OpenAEON，可持续性基线不足
元数据描述的 AEON 协议/chaosScore/Auto-Seal 等特性在所提供源码中无对应实现证据，文档与代码脱节
package.json 的 name/homepage/repository 仍指向 openclaw 上游，fork 身份与包发布路径混乱
构建链依赖 pnpm+Bun+Node≥22 并对 ARM 架构有兼容性妥协，跨平台部署成本偏高
concerns_en: README states the project is no longer maintained and users should migrate to OpenAEON, weakening sustainability
AEON protocol/chaosScore/Auto-Seal features claimed in metadata have no corresponding implementation in the sampled source
package.json name/homepage/repository still point to the upstream openclaw repo, blurring fork identity and publish path
Build requires pnpm + Bun + Node >=22 with ARM-specific workarounds, raising cross-platform deployment cost

projects.name: continue
projects.description: open-source coding agent
projects.summary_zh: 成熟但已归档的多端编码代理 | 适合作为参考基线
projects.summary_en: Mature but archived multi-client coding agent | Suitable as a reference baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合参考与二次开发，不宜作为新项目核心依赖
projects.recommendation_en: Useful for reference and secondary development, but unsuitable as a core dependency for new projects
highlights_zh: TypeScript多组件架构，覆盖CLI、VS Code与JetBrains客户端
CI覆盖Linux、Windows、macOS及多个Node.js版本，包含lint、冒烟、端到端和API测试
highlights_en: TypeScript multi-component architecture spanning CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains clients
CI covers Linux, Windows, macOS, multiple Node.js versions, linting, smoke, end-to-end, and API tests
concerns_zh: 仓库已明确停止维护并设为只读，缺乏持续修复、依赖升级与漏洞响应能力
根级工程配置偏轻，且存在已禁用或绑定特殊分支的遗留自动化流程，CI治理仍可整理
concerns_en: The repository is explicitly read-only and unmaintained, with no ongoing fixes, dependency upgrades, or vulnerability response
Root-level engineering configuration is relatively thin, while disabled or branch-specific legacy automation indicates unfinished CI governance

projects.name: KKTerm
projects.description: Super-tool for vibe coders & system admins — terminals, SSH, SFTP, RDP/VNC, dashboards, install helpers, and a built-in AI assistant.
projects.summary_zh: 功能覆盖广的跨平台运维桌面工作台，工程实现仍待核验
projects.summary_en: Broad cross-platform operations desktop with implementation still requiring verification
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试用，引入前审查安全与测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; audit security and tests before adoption
highlights_zh: Tauri、React、TypeScript与Rust组合支持Windows和macOS跨平台交付
提供自定义模块、MCP、Assistant Skills及AI生成Widget等扩展机制
highlights_en: Tauri, React, TypeScript, and Rust support cross-platform delivery across Windows and macOS
Custom modules, MCP, assistant skills, and AI-generated widgets provide clear extension paths
concerns_zh: 源码样本仅含多语言README，未提供TypeScript或Rust实现代码，无法验证核心代码质量、异常处理和测试覆盖
项目同时覆盖终端、远程桌面、文件传输和AI操作等高风险能力，文档主张的权限隔离与安全边界需进一步审计
主要由独立开发者维护，功能范围和发布频率较高，长期治理与模块复杂度可能带来维护压力
concerns_en: The source sample contains only localized READMEs, with no TypeScript or Rust implementation to verify core quality, error handling, or test coverage
Terminals, remote desktops, file transfer, and AI operations create a broad security surface whose permission isolation and trust boundaries require further auditing
Independent leadership and a rapidly expanding feature set may create long-term maintenance and complexity pressures

projects.name: ocode
projects.description: OCode is a sophisticated terminal-native AI coding assistant that provides deep codebase intelligence and autonomous task execution
projects.summary_zh: 功能覆盖完整但安全门禁与发布链路偏弱的早期 AI 编码助手
projects.summary_en: A feature-rich early-stage AI coding assistant with weak security gating and release validation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试验选型，生产使用前需强化门禁
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; harden security gates before production adoption
highlights_zh: CI覆盖多操作系统、Python 3.8至3.13，并集成格式化、静态检查、测试和覆盖率
通过MCP、CLI入口及可选依赖提供较清晰的扩展路径
highlights_en: CI covers major operating systems and Python 3.8-3.13 with formatting, static analysis, tests, and coverage
MCP, a CLI entry point, and optional dependencies provide a clear extension path
concerns_zh: Bandit与Safety扫描均使用continue-on-error，安全漏洞不会阻止合并
Docker仅复制setup.py而未复制pyproject.toml，与声明式构建配置存在不一致风险
依赖缺少上限约束和锁文件，且项目版本固定为0.1.0、尚未正式发布
PR快速检查仅输出警告，不执行测试和类型检查，安全门禁明显弱于主CI
concerns_en: Bandit and Safety scans use continue-on-error, so vulnerabilities do not block merging
The Docker image copies setup.py without pyproject.toml, creating packaging inconsistency risk
Dependencies lack upper bounds or a lockfile, while the static 0.1.0 version has never been released
The PR quick-check workflow only emits warnings and skips tests and type checking

projects.name: Clawlet
projects.description: 🌸 A lightweight AI agent framework with identity awareness inspired by OpenClaw, aimed to be very simple to set up and easy to use, get up and running in 2 minutes.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量本地优先的模块化智能体框架 | 工程化基线尚待验证
projects.summary_en: Lightweight local-first modular agent framework with a promising engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型验证，生产采用前需审查核心源码与安全边界
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototyping; review core code and security boundaries before production
highlights_zh: 按任务配置模型、提供商、工具集与预算，扩展边界清晰
采用统一注册表、隔离子智能体和 SQLite 会话库，架构目标明确
提供 uv 锁文件、Hatchling 打包、CI 冒烟测试与发布回归流程
支持本地模型、最小权限工具集、密钥脱敏和安全执行模式
highlights_en: Per-task provider, model, toolset, and budget configuration creates clear extension boundaries
A unified registry, isolated sub-agents, and SQLite session store support a coherent architecture
uv locking, Hatchling packaging, CI smoke tests, and release regression checks improve delivery discipline
Local models, least-privilege toolsets, secret masking, and safe execution modes support security-oriented defaults
concerns_zh: 未提供核心 Python 源码样本，无法验证实现质量、异常处理与权限隔离是否真实落地
项目仍处于 Alpha 阶段，当前仅一名贡献者且发布次数少，维护与交付风险较高
CI 覆盖率仅报告、不设失败阈值，也没有静态类型检查或 lint 步骤
.gitignore 忽略 clawlet/tests，可能使部分测试无法进入版本库
依赖同时包含 httpx 与 aiohttp，核心安装的轻量性需要进一步量化
concerns_en: No core Python implementation was sampled, so implementation quality, error handling, and privilege isolation cannot be verified
The project remains alpha-stage with one contributor and few releases, creating maintenance and delivery risk
CI reports coverage without a failing threshold and includes no static type-checking or lint gate
The repository ignore rules exclude clawlet/tests, which may prevent part of the test suite from being committed
Using both httpx and aiohttp in core dependencies may weaken the lightweight installation objective

projects.name: lettabot
projects.description: Archived - has been replaced by Letta Code channels/schedules!
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整的多渠道 AI 机器人，但项目已归档且停止维护
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich multi-channel AI bot with solid tooling, but it is archived and unmaintained
projects.recommendation_zh: 存量可用，新项目优先选择 Letta Code
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for existing use; prefer Letta Code for new projects
highlights_zh: TypeScript 模块化构建，提供统一 CLI、SDK 与多渠道适配入口
CI 覆盖类型构建、单元测试、E2E 测试及 Docker 镜像构建
highlights_en: Modular TypeScript build with a unified CLI, SDK integration, and multi-channel entry points
CI validates type builds, unit tests, E2E tests, and Docker image builds
concerns_zh: README 明确声明项目已弃用并停止维护，新功能和修复已迁移至 Letta Code
Signal、WhatsApp 等通道依赖原生模块或外部系统，部署兼容性与升级成本较高
缺少依赖安全扫描、覆盖率门槛和长期支持承诺，patch-package 失败还会被静默忽略
concerns_en: The README explicitly marks the project deprecated and unmaintained, with new work moved to Letta Code
Signal and WhatsApp integrations rely on native modules or external services, increasing deployment and upgrade costs
There is no dependency security scanning or coverage threshold, while patch-package failures are silently ignored

projects.name: Canopy
projects.description: A local-first, encrypted Slack/Discord alternative built for the agentic era. AI agents, such as openclaw, join channels, receive tasks, and coordinate on equal footing with humans — over a serverless P2P mesh.
projects.summary_zh: 早期阶段的本地优先加密协作平台，工程基线完整但仍缺少自动化测试闭环
projects.summary_en: Early-stage local-first encrypted collaboration platform with a solid engineering baseline but an incomplete automated test loop
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产部署前补齐测试与依赖锁定
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; add test coverage and dependency locking before production
highlights_zh: 提供Python 3.10至3.12多版本CI，并执行编译、导入、模板及JavaScript语法检查
通过setuptools、命令行入口、可选MCP与托盘扩展支持模块化部署
highlights_en: CI validates Python 3.10-3.12 with compilation, import, template, and JavaScript syntax checks
Setuptools entry points, optional MCP integration, and tray extras support modular deployment
concerns_zh: CI未运行pytest、覆盖率、flake8、black或mypy，贡献文档要求的测试流程未形成门禁
依赖主要采用宽松版本范围，Docker安装过程未使用uv.lock锁定依赖
concerns_en: CI does not run pytest, coverage, flake8, black, or mypy, leaving the documented test workflow outside the quality gate
Dependencies mostly use loose version ranges, and the Docker installation does not lock them with uv.lock

projects.name: GoGogot
projects.description: Lightweight self-hosted AI agent. Open-source OpenClaw alternative in Go.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量自托管插件化助手 | 可扩展但工程保障偏弱
projects.summary_en: Lightweight self-hosted plugin agent with strong extensibility but limited engineering assurance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试用，生产部署前需补齐测试与CI
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials; add tests and CI before production use
highlights_zh: 单二进制并提供 amd64、arm64 镜像，部署与跨架构支持清晰
通过 Adapter、Channel、render.Surface 等小接口支持多提供商和跨语言插件扩展
highlights_en: Provides a single binary with linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 container support
Uses small Adapter, Channel, and render.Surface interfaces for providers and cross-language plugins
concerns_zh: 仓库无 CI/CD 且仅一名核心贡献者，变更验证、发布自动化和巴士因子存在明显风险
提供的样本未包含核心 Go 实现与测试，无法核实错误处理、权限边界和并发安全；Telegram 插件还引入 Python 运行时依赖
concerns_en: No CI/CD and only one core contributor create release, validation, and bus-factor risks

The supplied sample omits core Go implementation and tests, preventing verification of error handling, permission boundaries, and concurrency; the Telegram plugin also adds a Python runtime dependency

projects.name: career-ops
projects.description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
projects.summary_zh: 文档驱动的多平台 AI 求职智能体 | 社区可持续性较强
projects.summary_en: Documentation-driven, multi-platform AI job-search agent with a strong community foundation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试用，团队落地前需审查核心代码
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for individual trials; audit core code before team adoption
highlights_zh: 支持 Codex、OpenCode 等 CLI 及 Claude Code 插件，部署与集成场景较广
拥有 CI/CD、频繁发布和大量贡献者，并提供二十余种语言的本地化文档
highlights_en: Supports Codex, OpenCode, other AI CLIs, and a Claude Code plugin across diverse integration environments
Has CI/CD, frequent releases, a large contributor base, and documentation localized into more than twenty languages
concerns_zh: 源码样本仅包含被截断的 README，缺少核心 JavaScript 实现、测试、依赖与安全策略，无法充分验证代码质量、健壮性和可维护性
concerns_en: The source sample contains only truncated READMEs, omitting the core JavaScript implementation, tests, dependencies, and security policies needed to verify code quality, robustness, and maintainability

projects.name: oli
projects.description: A simple, fast terminal based AI coding assistant
projects.summary_zh: 工程化基础较完整的早期混合架构编码助手
projects.summary_en: Early-stage coding assistant with a well-structured hybrid architecture and solid engineering foundations
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试用，暂不建议直接用于生产环境
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials, but not recommended for production use yet
highlights_zh: Rust后端与React/Ink前端职责分离清晰，扩展多模型与工具能力较方便
具备格式化、静态检查、覆盖率、基准测试及发布流水线
highlights_en: Clear separation between the Rust backend and React/Ink frontend supports extensible model and tool integrations
Includes formatting, static analysis, coverage, benchmarking, and publishing workflows
concerns_zh: 项目明确处于早期阶段且容易出现缺陷，TypeScript前端尚无实际测试
Node.js要求23.10以上且仅声明macOS与Linux支持，部署兼容性受限
基准测试依赖自托管GPU和本地Ollama，CI可重复性与日常维护成本较高
concerns_en: The project explicitly remains early-stage and bug-prone, while the TypeScript frontend has no real test suite
Node.js 23.10 or newer is required and only macOS and Linux are declared as supported
Benchmarks depend on a self-hosted GPU and local Ollama, increasing maintenance cost and reducing CI reproducibility

projects.name: formax
projects.description: Terminal-first AI assistant for software engineering tasks (inspired by Claude Code v2.0.67)
projects.summary_zh: 架构治理严谨的 Beta 级终端 AI 助手 | 单一维护者可持续性存疑
projects.summary_en: Well-governed beta terminal AI assistant with a single-maintainer sustainability risk
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合学习与二次开发，不建议生产主力使用
projects.recommendation_en: Good for learning and extension; avoid as a production mainstay
highlights_zh: 分层架构清晰：语义真值/运行编排/适配渲染三层解耦，并有 boundary 与 golden-principle 脚本强制约束
工程门禁完善：CI 覆盖 type-check、vitest 覆盖率阈值、bundle 基线与语义/perf 回归门禁，契约文档与代码同步治理
highlights_en: Clear layering (canonical semantics / orchestration / adapters) with automated boundary and golden-principle checks
Strong CI gates: type-check, coverage thresholds, bundle baselines, semantic and performance regression guards
concerns_zh: 单一贡献者、0 次发布，Beta 阶段且 README 自述 WebFetch/WebSearch 不稳定、MCP 未支持
根目录脚本数量膨胀（数十个 check/test 脚本）带来治理复杂度，构建依赖 Bun、Node>=20 存在工具链耦合
concerns_en: Single contributor, zero releases, beta stage with acknowledged unstable WebFetch/WebSearch and no MCP support
Dozens of root-level check/test scripts add governance overhead; build depends on Bun while Node>=20 is required

projects.name: pickle-bot
projects.description: Your own AI assistant, speak like a cat.
projects.summary_zh: 扩展性突出的个人AI助手 | 工程规范良好但部署可靠性不足
projects.summary_en: Extensible personal AI assistant with solid engineering conventions but deployment reliability gaps
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人实验与二次开发，生产部署前需补强
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal use and extension, but harden before production
highlights_zh: 采用src布局、类型化配置及标准CLI入口，发布与依赖管理规范
支持代理、Markdown技能、定时任务和HTTP API，扩展路径清晰
highlights_en: Uses a src layout, typed configuration, and a standard CLI entry point with disciplined release tooling
Provides clear extension paths through agents, Markdown skills, scheduled jobs, and an HTTP API
concerns_zh: Docker构建未复制default_workspace，且使用latest工具镜像，构建可复现性存在风险
CI仅执行pytest，未运行ruff、mypy或覆盖率检查
仅支持Python 3.13且依赖较多，降低跨平台部署能力
concerns_en: The Docker build omits default_workspace and uses a latest tool image, reducing reproducibility
CI runs only pytest and omits ruff, mypy, and coverage enforcement
Python 3.13-only support and a broad dependency set limit cross-platform deployment

projects.name: atombot
projects.description: A tiny but powerful personal AI assistant 🐙
projects.summary_zh: 轻量模块化个人AI助手 | 原型级工程基线
projects.summary_en: Lightweight modular personal AI assistant with a prototype-grade engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验，暂不建议直接用于生产
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials, but not recommended for production without further hardening
highlights_zh: 核心模块按代理、渠道、模型适配器、调度器和技能清晰分层
支持Python 3.9以上版本，配置规范简洁且包发布元数据完整
highlights_en: Clear separation of agent, channel, provider, scheduler, and skill components
Supports Python 3.9+ with concise configuration and complete packaging metadata
concerns_zh: 缺少CI、自动化测试和覆盖率保障，且核心实现、异常处理与安全边界无法从样本验证
项目由单一贡献者维护且无正式发布记录，长期维护与升级风险较高
concerns_en: No CI, automated tests, or coverage guarantees are provided, while core implementation, error handling, and security boundaries remain unverified
Single-maintainer ownership and no formal release history create long-term maintenance and upgrade risk

projects.name: jrdev
projects.description: JrDev is a free open-source AI developer assistant for the terminal. It provides CLI/TUI interfaces to interact with LLMs for code generation, project context management, and Git operations.
projects.summary_zh: 早期阶段的终端 AI 编码助手 | 模块化架构清晰但工程基线偏薄
projects.summary_en: Early-stage terminal AI coding assistant with clean modular architecture but a thin engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合尝鲜与二次开发，生产使用需评估稳定性
projects.recommendation_en: Fine for experimentation and extension; assess stability before production use
highlights_zh: AGENTS.md 明确划分 core/commands/agents/services/prompts/ui 分层，提示词与代码解耦
CI 覆盖 Python 3.9-3.12 多版本 pytest 并上传覆盖率报告
highlights_en: Clear core/commands/agents/services/prompts/ui layering with prompts decoupled from code
CI runs pytest across Python 3.9-3.12 with coverage artifacts
concerns_zh: pylint 关闭 broad-exception-caught 等关键检查，异常处理与类型规范可能被弱化
依赖安装直接使用 requirements.txt，缺锁文件与版本约束，可复现性风险
项目自述为 Early Access，破坏性变更频繁，接口稳定性不足
concerns_en: pylint disables broad-exception-caught and similar checks, weakening error-handling rigor
CI installs from unpinned requirements.txt without a lock file, hurting reproducibility
Self-declared Early Access software with frequent breaking changes and unstable APIs

projects.name: openzca
projects.description: Free to use alternative zcacli for integrate Zalo with OpenClaw
projects.summary_zh: 功能完善且面向生产集成的 Zalo CLI，但架构集中、CI 与维护力量不足
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich production-oriented Zalo CLI, but with centralized architecture, limited CI, and a narrow maintenance base
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合受控集成，生产前补齐CI并拆分核心
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for controlled integration; add CI and modularize the core before production
highlights_zh: 覆盖认证、消息、媒体、群组、监听与本地数据库等完整能力
具备监听重连、原生视频降级、文本分块及类型检查等稳定性设计
highlights_en: Comprehensive authentication, messaging, media, group, listener, and local database capabilities
Stability-oriented listener reconnection, native-video fallback, text chunking, and type checking
concerns_zh: 约5400行CLI入口集中注册命令和业务处理，增加回归与协作风险
无CI/CD且仅一名贡献者，发布与长期维护存在单点风险
要求Node.js 22.13+并使用node:sqlite，原生视频还依赖ffmpeg，环境可移植性受限
concerns_en: The roughly 5,400-line CLI entrypoint combines command registration and handlers, increasing regression and collaboration risk
No CI/CD and only one contributor create a release and long-term maintenance single point of failure
Node.js 22.13+, node:sqlite, and optional ffmpeg requirements limit environment portability

projects.name: angel-claw
projects.description: Lean. Compatible. Based OpenClaw. Python ❤️ (14k downloads)
projects.summary_zh: 功能导向的多租户智能体框架 | 工程化基线尚不完整
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich multi-tenant agent framework with an incomplete engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产采用前补齐依赖锁定与CI测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; add dependency locking and CI before production
highlights_zh: 分层技能注册、MCP接入与多模型支持体现良好扩展设计
提供租户隔离、加密密钥库、调度限流及执行超时等安全机制
highlights_en: Tiered skills, MCP integration, and multi-model support provide a strong extension model
Tenant isolation, encrypted vaults, fair-share scheduling, and execution timeouts address key security needs
concerns_zh: 核心依赖未锁定版本且缺少可复现构建的依赖锁文件
无CI/CD配置，缺少持续测试、静态检查与发布质量门禁
项目描述存在FastAPI与Flask混用，且可编辑本地依赖影响独立安装
源码样本不足，无法验证沙箱隔离、认证授权和加密实现的安全性
concerns_en: Core dependencies are unpinned and no reproducible dependency lock file is present
No CI/CD configuration provides continuous testing, static analysis, or release quality gates
FastAPI and Flask are both referenced, while an editable local dependency may impede standalone installation
The supplied sample lacks implementation code needed to verify sandboxing, authorization, and encryption

projects.name: supaclaw
projects.description: A basic version of OpenClaw but built entirely on Supabase built-in features.
projects.summary_zh: Supabase原生多渠道代理框架 | 架构精简但工程成熟度待验证
projects.summary_en: Supabase-native multi-channel agent framework with lean architecture and unverified engineering maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合PoC，生产引入前需验证可靠性与安全实现
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for PoC; validate reliability and security before production adoption
highlights_zh: 数据库、存储、认证、任务队列与定时调度统一采用Supabase原生能力
提供架构、安全、部署、测试及产品需求文档，并规划多渠道与技能扩展
highlights_en: Uses Supabase primitives across data, storage, auth, job orchestration, and scheduling
Provides architecture, security, deployment, testing, and product documentation with multi-channel extensibility plans
concerns_zh: 源码样本未展示实际TypeScript实现，重试、幂等、审计回滚与RLS安全性无法核实
缺少CI/CD与正式发布，基础自动化交付保障不足
核心运行模型高度依赖Supabase与Deno，跨平台迁移成本较高
concerns_en: The sample contains no TypeScript implementation, so retry, idempotency, audit-revert, and RLS claims cannot be verified
No CI/CD pipeline or formal release is indicated, limiting automated delivery assurance
The runtime model is tightly coupled to Supabase and Deno, increasing migration cost

projects.name: lossless-claw-enhanced
projects.description: Fork of Martian-Engineering/lossless-claw with CJK-aware token estimation
projects.summary_zh: 已停止维护的 CJK 感知上下文压缩插件 fork，工程基线尚可但功能已并入上游
projects.summary_en: A deprecated CJK-aware context-compaction fork with sound engineering baseline but all features merged upstream
projects.recommendation_zh: 新项目直接采用 upstream，仅存量集成需短期过渡
projects.recommendation_en: Adopt upstream directly; use this fork only as a short-term migration bridge for existing installs
highlights_zh: CJK/Emoji 感知的 token 估算统一到单一 estimate-tokens 模块，替代上游 length/4 误差
幂等数据迁移重算历史 token_count，并配 18 条迁移与估算测试用例
工程化完善：vitest 测试、changesets 版本管理、CI/发布/版本 PR 三条 GitHub 工作流
cherry-pick 上游关键缺陷修复（auth 误判、会话轮转、空消息反馈循环）并经 Codex 复审补正
highlights_en: Unified CJK/emoji-aware token estimation in a single module, fixing upstream length/4 undercount
Idempotent migration recalculates token_count with 18 dedicated test cases
Solid tooling: vitest, changesets, and three CI/release/version workflows
Curated upstream bugfixes for auth false positives, session rotation, and empty-message feedback loops
concerns_zh: README 明确声明 DEPRECATED，版本停在 0.5.3 且落后上游约 6 个 minor 版本，不再维护
无法编译适配当前 OpenClaw 2026.5.x，存在明确升级阻断风险
package.json 仍保留上游包名与仓库地址，fork 身份与发布归属混乱
零发布次数、无 releases 记录，且 Dockerfile 中 npm run build 带 || true 掩盖构建失败
concerns_en: Explicitly deprecated at v0.5.3, ~6 minor versions behind upstream, and no longer maintained
No longer compiles against current OpenClaw 2026.5.x, creating a hard upgrade blocker
package.json still carries upstream package name and repository URL, blurring fork identity and publish ownership
Zero published releases, and Dockerfile masks build failure via `npm run build || true`

projects.name: trinity-claw
projects.description: A self-hosted AI agent that thinks, acts, and improves itself – all running privately on your own machine. Browses the web, writes and executes code, manages files, sends emails, monitors URLs, builds websites, and learns from every interaction.
projects.summary_zh: 功能导向的自托管AI代理 | 扩展性较好但安全与运维基线不足
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich self-hosted AI agent with good extensibility but limited security and operational hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合本地试验，暂不建议直接生产部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for local trials, but not recommended for production deployment
highlights_zh: 服务按代理、模型网关、向量库、数据库和前端分层，模块边界清晰
支持动态技能、只读核心目录及多种本地与云端模型接入，扩展路径成熟
highlights_en: Clear service separation across the agent, model gateway, vector database, database, and frontend
Mature extension model with dynamic skills, read-only core directories, and broad model integration
concerns_zh: API缺少多用户认证和限流，且更新器挂载Docker套接字与整个仓库写权限，攻击面较大
数据库使用固定弱口令并存在777权限，依赖镜像未固定摘要，CI缺少测试与安全扫描
concerns_en: The API lacks multi-user authentication and rate limiting, while the updater mounts the Docker socket and the entire repository with write access
The database uses fixed weak credentials and permissive permissions, images are not digest-pinned, and CI lacks tests and security scanning

projects.name: mimiclaw
projects.description: MimiClaw: Personal Agent on a $5 chip. No OS(Linux). No Node.js. No Mac mini. No Raspberry Pi. No VPS. Hardware agents OS. On device Muse.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量纯C边缘智能体 | 多提供商扩展尚缺验证基线
projects.summary_en: Lightweight pure-C edge agent with extensible providers but limited verification evidence
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型验证，生产部署前需补齐自动化测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototyping; add automated tests before production deployment
highlights_zh: 纯C实现并面向ESP32-S3资源受限环境
支持Anthropic与OpenAI运行时切换及NVS配置覆盖
highlights_en: Pure-C implementation tailored to constrained ESP32-S3 hardware
Runtime Anthropic/OpenAI switching with NVS-backed configuration overrides
concerns_zh: CI仅执行固件编译，未配置单元测试、静态分析或硬件在环测试
发布指南与README的串口命令命名不一致，增加配置失败风险
源码样本未展示内存边界、错误恢复与密钥保护实现
concerns_en: CI only compiles firmware, with no unit tests, static analysis, or hardware-in-the-loop checks
Release instructions use serial commands that differ from the README, increasing setup risk
The provided source sample does not demonstrate memory-safety, recovery, or secret-protection implementation

projects.name: droidclaw
projects.description: turn old phones into ai agents - give it a goal in plain english. it reads the screen, thinks about what to do, taps and types via adb, and repeats until the job is done.
projects.summary_zh: 多提供商驱动的 Android 智能体框架 | 适合实验验证，生产保障不足
projects.summary_en: Multi-provider Android agent framework with solid experimentation foundations but limited production assurance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型验证，生产部署前需强化测试与安全控制
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototyping; add testing and security controls before production
highlights_zh: 感知、推理、动作职责分离，常量与配置集中管理，TypeScript 类型清晰
支持 Groq、OpenAI、Bedrock、OpenRouter 和 Ollama，动作与提供商具备扩展接口
highlights_en: Clear separation of perception, reasoning, and actions with centralized configuration and typed interfaces
Extensible provider and action interfaces supporting Groq, OpenAI, Bedrock, OpenRouter, and Ollama
concerns_zh: ADB 重试依赖 stderr 文本包含 error，未检查退出码，且数值配置缺少有效性与范围校验
依赖 Bun 运行时、Android ADB 和本地环境，测试脚本含绝对路径且未见正式测试套件
无 CI/CD，贡献者较少，bun.lock 被忽略，发布与依赖可复现性存在风险
concerns_en: ADB retries rely on stderr text and ignore exit codes, while numeric configuration lacks validity and range checks
The Bun runtime, Android ADB, and local paths constrain portability; the visible test is ad hoc and uses an absolute path
No CI/CD, few contributors, and an ignored bun.lock weaken release and dependency reproducibility

projects.name: cmux
projects.description: Open source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications for AI coding agents. Built for multitasking, organization, and programmability.
projects.summary_zh: 原生 macOS AI 编程终端 | 扩展接口完善但代码证据有限
projects.summary_en: Native macOS AI coding terminal with strong extensibility but limited code evidence
projects.recommendation_zh: 建议试用，规模化前审查核心实现
projects.recommendation_en: Recommended for trials; audit core implementation before large-scale adoption
highlights_zh: 采用 Swift 与 AppKit 构建原生 macOS 客户端
提供 CLI、Socket API、自定义命令及浏览器自动化接口
highlights_en: Native macOS client built with Swift and AppKit
Provides CLI, socket API, custom commands, and browser automation interfaces
concerns_zh: 样本仅包含多语言 README，缺少核心 Swift 源码、测试与错误处理实现
平台绑定 macOS、Ghostty 与 libghostty，跨平台迁移能力有限
大量由 AI 生成的翻译 README 存在内容漂移和重复维护成本
concerns_en: The sample contains only multilingual READMEs, with no core Swift source, tests, or error-handling evidence
The product is tightly coupled to macOS, Ghostty, and libghostty, limiting cross-platform portability
AI-generated translated READMEs create drift and duplicated maintenance costs

projects.name: openclaw-android-assistant
projects.description: 🦞 AnyClaw — OpenClaw + Codex + Claude Code on Android. Three AI agents in one APK. Claw Code / OpenClaude running in full Linux. No root. No server. No PC.
projects.summary_zh: 功能集成丰富的移动端多智能体助手 | 自动化与发布治理仍待强化
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich mobile multi-agent assistant with automation and release-governance gaps
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合技术试点，生产采用前强化发布与合并治理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for technical pilots; harden release and merge governance before production use
highlights_zh: 通过插件选择脚本与分层构建支持可选扩展和可复现镜像
依赖覆盖、基础镜像摘要固定及定时上游同步体现持续维护意识
highlights_en: Plugin-selection scripts and layered builds support optional extensions and reproducible images
Dependency overrides, pinned image digests, and scheduled upstream syncs show strong maintenance intent
concerns_zh: APK 工作流在 npm ci 失败时回退安装依赖，并直接发布未签名的 debug 构建
上游同步任务吞掉合并错误并自动以固定策略解决冲突，存在代码覆盖与供应链风险
concerns_en: The APK workflow falls back to non-reproducible dependency installation and publishes an unsigned debug build
The upstream-sync job suppresses merge failures and resolves conflicts automatically, creating overwrite and supply-chain risks

projects.name: nanoclaw-py
projects.description: Yet another nano alternative to OpenClaw. It can read/write files, execute commands, search the web, and schedule tasks — all in ~500 lines of Python.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量教学型 Telegram 智能体 | 适合原型验证
projects.summary_en: A lightweight educational Telegram agent best suited for prototype validation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合学习与个人原型，暂不建议直接生产部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for learning and personal prototypes, but not production deployment without hardening
highlights_zh: 依赖与运行要求清晰，并通过 episodes 提供渐进式课程
集成文件操作、命令执行、网页搜索、任务调度与会话持久化
highlights_en: Clear dependency and runtime requirements with progressively structured course episodes
Integrates file operations, command execution, web search, scheduling, and session persistence
concerns_zh: 缺少 CI/CD、自动化测试和正式发布记录，可靠性保障不足
仅支持 Python 3.12+ 且依赖 Claude Code CLI 与类 Unix Shell 环境
核心源码样本未提供，无法验证权限控制、错误恢复及并发安全实现
项目由单一贡献者维护，长期治理与迭代连续性存在风险
concerns_en: No CI/CD, automated tests, or formal releases provide insufficient reliability assurance
Requires Python 3.12+, Claude Code CLI, and a Unix-like shell environment
Core source was not included, preventing verification of authorization, recovery, and concurrency safety
Single-contributor maintenance creates continuity and long-term governance risk

projects.name: hermitclaw
projects.summary_zh: 轻量级持续自主代理 | 文档清晰但安全与工程化不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight autonomous agent with clear design, but limited production hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合实验研究，生产使用需强隔离与补齐测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for research; add strong isolation and testing for production
highlights_zh: README 对思考循环、工具机制、记忆与部署流程说明清晰
配置集中且支持 OpenAI、OpenRouter、自定义端点及 Ollama
highlights_en: Clearly documents the thinking loop, tools, memory, and setup workflow
Centralized configuration supports several LLM providers and local models
concerns_zh: 项目明确承认 shell 与网络工具的防护可绕过，不能视为安全边界
未提供 CI/CD，样本中也未见测试、锁文件或发布流程
concerns_en: The project explicitly states that shell and web guardrails are bypassable
No CI/CD is present, and the sample provides no visible tests, lockfile, or release workflow

projects.name: shrew
projects.summary_zh: 轻量零依赖 Go CLI Agent | 基础架构清晰但安全边界不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight zero-dependency Go CLI agent with a clear base but weak security boundaries
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型验证，生产使用前需补齐安全与可靠性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototyping; harden security and reliability before production use
highlights_zh: 单二进制、零依赖且支持 Linux 与 macOS 交叉编译，部署便携性较好
Daemon 采用 Context、WaitGroup 和接口化 Channel，基础模块边界清晰
highlights_en: Single zero-dependency binary with Linux and macOS cross-compilation
Daemon uses context cancellation, wait groups, and channel interfaces
concerns_zh: 文件读写仅转换为绝对路径但未限制根目录，仍可任意覆盖主机文件
HTTP 请求缺少超时、状态码处理仅接受 200，响应体读取也未设上限
Shell 命令通过字符串分割执行，无法正确处理引号、管道及重定向语义
concerns_en: File operations only resolve absolute paths without enforcing a root boundary, allowing arbitrary host-file writes
HTTP calls lack timeouts, reject every non-200 response, and read error bodies without a size limit
Shell commands are split on whitespace, breaking quoted arguments, pipelines, and redirection semantics

projects.name: babyclaw
projects.description: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw built on Claude Agent SDK.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量单文件Telegram智能体 | 原型可用但工程化不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight single-file Telegram agent with functional foundations but limited production engineering
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验，暂不建议直接生产部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials, but not recommended for immediate production use
highlights_zh: 单文件启动且依赖精简，部署与二次体验门槛低
实现会话持久化、消息排队、中断及多类Telegram消息处理
highlights_en: Minimal single-file startup with a small dependency footprint
Implements session persistence, message queuing, interruption, and multiple Telegram input types
concerns_zh: 核心逻辑集中于index.js且功能持续扩张，后续维护和测试成本较高
状态文件采用非原子写入，异常时可能损坏且缺少恢复机制
启用bypassPermissions并允许代理执行高权限命令，缺少细粒度安全边界
缺少CI/CD、自动化测试、锁文件及严格依赖版本管理
自定义环境变量解析和状态持久化缺少统一封装，异常处理过于静默
concerns_en: Core behavior is concentrated in index.js despite broad feature growth, increasing maintenance and testing costs
State is persisted with a non-atomic write and has no explicit corruption recovery path
bypassPermissions and unrestricted agent command execution create a weak fine-grained security boundary
No CI/CD, automated tests, lockfile, or strict dependency version management is provided
Custom environment parsing and persistence lack shared utilities, while several error paths are silently ignored

projects.name: ZeroClaw-Android
projects.description: Run AI agents 24/7 on your Android phone. Native Rust core, 25+ providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek,         Ollama), encrypted key storage, plugin browser, Material You UI. Self-hosted alternative to Mac Mini setups. MIT           licensed.
projects.summary_zh: 已归档的高风险实验性安卓AI代理项目
projects.summary_en: Archived, high-risk experimental Android AI agent project
projects.recommendation_zh: 不建议生产使用，需审计并接替维护
projects.recommendation_en: Avoid production use; audit and establish replacement maintenance
highlights_zh: 原生Rust核心并集成25个以上模型提供商
支持加密密钥存储、插件浏览及Material You界面
highlights_en: Native Rust core with support for more than 25 model providers
Includes encrypted key storage, plugin browsing, and Material You UI
concerns_zh: 项目已明确归档，并承认代码大部分由AI生成且范围过大、存在安全风险
仅有一名贡献者且无CI/CD，后续缺陷修复和依赖升级缺少持续保障
缺少可审计的源码样本，无法验证供应商适配、密钥管理和插件机制的实际质量
concerns_en: The project is explicitly archived and described as largely AI-generated, overly scoped, and unsafe
Only one contributor and no CI/CD leave defect fixes and dependency upgrades without continuous assurance
No auditable source sample is available to validate provider integrations, key management, or plugin security

projects.name: Aivy-OS
projects.description: Your own digital life form — local AI companion with persistent memory, IDE workspace, MCP support, and 30+ tools. Companion-first alternative to Hermes Agent / OpenClaw / Claude Code.
projects.summary_zh: 闭源Windows桌面AI伴侣 | 文档完善但源码不可审计
projects.summary_en: Closed-source Windows AI companion with polished docs but no auditable source code
projects.recommendation_zh: 仅适合尝鲜，不建议严肃生产选型
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for evaluation, but not recommended for serious production adoption
highlights_zh: 中英文文档完整，功能、隐私、系统要求与发布流程说明清晰
设计上支持多模型、本地推理、插件与MCP扩展
highlights_en: Comprehensive Chinese and English documentation covering features, privacy, requirements, and releases
The design supports multiple models, local inference, plugins, and MCP extensions
concerns_zh: 仓库仅发布文档和截图，核心程序以闭源二进制形式分发，无法评估实际代码质量、异常处理与安全性
项目仅支持Windows x64，且无CI/CD、单一贡献者，跨平台能力与长期维护风险较高
concerns_en: The repository contains only documentation and screenshots while the application is distributed as closed-source binaries, preventing assessment of implementation quality, error handling, and security
The project is limited to Windows x64 and has no CI/CD or multiple maintainers, creating cross-platform and long-term maintenance risks
